analysis.executiveSummary: Ravens Regime proposes sending Derrick Henry and Tony Pollard to Corgi Loaf Baking Co. in exchange for David Montgomery, Mike Washington Jr., and Tyler Shough. While both franchises are pursuing a 'Win Championship' strategy, this submitted construction creates a strategic imbalance for the user: surrendering Derrick Henry (80.1 C-AVI) and Tony Pollard (66.8 C-AVI) severely weakens Ravens Regime's starting RB duo. Although acquiring Tyler Shough (48.3 C-AVI) provides a vital starting QB upgrade while Lamar Jackson remains inactive and rookie Mike Washington Jr. offers surging backfield volume, the user gives up too much elite RB production. AVI recommends revising the offer by requesting WR Ryan Flournoy (or a 2029 3rd-round pick) from Corgi Loaf to restore championship lineup equity.

submitted.summary: In the submitted 2-for-3 trade, Ravens Regime sends Derrick Henry (80.1 C-AVI) and Tony Pollard (66.8 C-AVI) for David Montgomery (53.8 C-AVI), Mike Washington Jr. (29.5 C-AVI), and Tyler Shough (48.3 C-AVI). While Tyler Shough fills an immediate hole at QB over Cam Ward (30.1 C-AVI) while Lamar Jackson is inactive, surrendering both starting RBs leaves Ravens Regime dependent on Kyle Monangai and Blake Corum alongside an injured Montgomery. Corgi Loaf Baking Co. gains massive RB starter firepower for their own title push, making the submitted structure overly generous to the trade partner.

recommended.summary: By expanding the offer to include Corgi Loaf WR Ryan Flournoy (49.2 C-AVI) alongside Montgomery, Washington Jr., and Shough, Ravens Regime secures essential WR/FLEX depth to cushion the loss of Derrick Henry and Tony Pollard. This creates a balanced win-win package where Corgi Loaf receives championship-clinching RB firepower while Ravens Regime upgrades QB1 and fortifies roster depth.

officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: Ravens Regime's weekly C-AVI at QB improves from 30.1 (Cam Ward) to 48.3 (Tyler Shough) during Lamar Jackson's inactivity (+18.2). However, starting RB C-AVI drops as Derrick Henry (80.1) and Tony Pollard (66.8) leave, forcing Kyle Monangai (58.5) and Blake Corum (54.5) / David Montgomery (53.8) into RB1/RB2 duties (-33.9 C-AVI net). Net weekly lineup impact is -15.7 C-AVI points.

For a Win Championship goal, the user needs additional current starting/FLEX equity to justify the RB drop-off.
